results.name: request rejection: GET/PUT/OPTIONS → 404 without CORS; Origin → 400; body > 32 KiB → 413; invalid JSON → 400; missing/invalid data.id → 400
signature: invalid v1 → 401; wrong secret → 401; x-request-id missing → 401; x-signature missing / malformed → 401; signed for another id → 401
payload consistency after a valid signature: query/body id mismatch, unknown type, payload live_mode=true, foreign user_id → 400; domain untouched
binding: seller mismatch (payment.collector_id) → 422; domain untouched
binding: seller mismatch (order.collector) → 422; domain untouched
binding: metadata.purchase_id mismatch → 422; domain untouched
binding: amount mismatch → 422; domain untouched
binding: currency mismatch → 422; domain untouched
binding: preference mismatch (order.preference_id) → 422; domain untouched
binding: payment live_mode=true → 422; domain untouched
binding: payment order type ≠ mercadopago → 422; domain untouched
binding: order does not list the payment → 422; domain untouched
binding: external_reference of ANOTHER existing purchase (metadata still ours) → 422; both purchases untouched
binding: external_reference of no purchase → 404 purchase_not_found; malformed external_reference → 422
chargeback binding: chargeback with two payments / live_mode=true / unknown payment → 422; domain untouched
pending → 200 pending; purchase pending; no grant
duplicate delivery of the same notification → 200, idempotent (one event)
approved (same payment, now accredited) → 200 approved; purchase approved; Premium grant granted and effective
approved duplicated → 200 duplicate_approved; no second grant
out-of-order: a late pending / rejected for the approved payment → 200 stale_ignored; purchase stays approved
requiresManualRefund: a second approved payment on the activated purchase → 200 (never 503) duplicate_payment, requiresManualRefund=true; one grant
chargeback (topic_chargebacks_wh, payment charged_back/in_process) → 200 reversal_applied; purchase charged_back; grant suspended
restored (charged_back/reimbursed) → 200 reversal_applied; purchase approved; grant restored and effective
refund (refunded) → 200 reversal_applied; purchase refunded; grant revoked; a later restore is ignored after revocation (200)
buyer_won (charged_back/settled after dispute) → 200; purchase charged_back; grant revoked
rejected / cancelled / expired are attempts: 200 attempt_*; purchase stays preference_created; a later approved on the same preference activates
payment id conflict: a payment already approved for another purchase, re-bound to this one → 422 (22023 TORNEOS_PAYMENT_CONFLICT); no second grant
unknown provider status → 202 accepted, domain untouched
provider 5xx (payment / merchant order / chargeback read) → 503, domain untouched; the retry then applies
no secret / PII in responses nor in torneos-functions / mp-stub logs (tokens, secrets, seller, DB URL, payer e-mail/document)
